name: D-Mon: Transform Friendships!!!
source:
In an altered Japan, the Irish 2000s boy band 'D-Sides' biggest fan and her D-Mon friend try to join the band  and prove she is the greatest singer, with bad results.

[From [url=https://digital-poppy.itch.io/d-mon-transform-friendships] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个发生改变的日本，爱尔兰2000年代男孩乐队“D-Sides”的头号粉丝与她的D-Mon朋友试图加入乐队，证明自己是最伟大的歌手，却遭遇了糟糕的结果。

（来源：[url=https://digital-poppy.itch.io/d-mon-transform-friendships]itch.io[/url]）
